    // The whole spring set: structural, then shear, then bend.
    GridSprings(self: ClothGrid3D, compliance: Number): Array<ClothDistanceConstraint>
        => self.GridRowSprings(1, compliance)
            .Concatenate(self.GridColumnSprings(1, compliance))
            .Concatenate(self.GridShearSprings(compliance))
            .Concatenate(self.GridRowSprings(2, compliance))
            .Concatenate(self.GridColumnSprings(2, compliance));
